title: Business Administration
tagline: Learn to lead organizations, build ventures, and make decisions grounded in evidence.
overview:
The Certificate in Business Administration is a three-year course of study in how organizations are built, managed, and led. You begin with the foundations of business, economics, accounting, management, and marketing, then master finance, analytics, operations, information systems, human resources, international business, and entrepreneurship.

In your final year you choose a concentration in finance, marketing, or entrepreneurship, study leadership and change, and bring the entire curriculum together in Strategic Management and a capstone project on a real business challenge.
outcomes: Analyze financial statements and use financial tools to evaluate business decisions.
Develop marketing, operational, and strategic plans grounded in data and market research.
Lead and collaborate effectively in diverse teams and organizations.
Apply ethical reasoning and legal principles to business situations.
Use analytics and information systems to improve organizational performance.
Communicate business ideas persuasively to professional audiences.
